company_description:
Aurelis Cloud is a Helsinki-headquartered AI infrastructure company operating across Europe. It provides GPU clusters, managed model inference, storage and networking for customers ranging from start-ups to large enterprises, and runs its own data centre in Finland while planning further European capacity.

Aurelis describes itself as engineering-first, with a focus on designing and reliably operating large-scale platforms. Its culture aims to combine a start-up atmosphere with meaningful engineering ownership: small teams run their services in production, developers and SREs share on-call duties, and incidents are reviewed without blame. The company values open exchange of ideas, equal participation, creativity, learning and tangible impact.

Aurelis offers flexible, remote-friendly work built on trust and autonomy, with support for home offices, wellbeing and healthcare benefits, clear development paths and regular team gatherings. Its people practices emphasize fairness and transparency across the countries where it hires. The company also runs a paid early-talent programme, pairing participants with mentors and giving them real production work.
